per_candidate.id: s2:CME-Flare Association and the Role of Reconnection in CME Acceleration

supporting_ids: s2:CME-Flare Association and the Role of Reconnection in CME Acceleration
rationale: The papers 'A Multi-Event Study of Early-Stage SEP Acceleration by CME-Driven Shocks' (2202.06013), 'CME-Flare Association and the Role of Reconnection in CME Acceleration', and 'Exploring the Dynamics of CME-Driven Shocks by Comparing Numerical Modeling and Observations' (2409.18020) provide insights into the acceleration mechanisms related to CMEs and their interactions with solar energetic particles, contributing to the understanding of the question.
